Platforms: iOS
An event that indicates a C function has been tampered with. In iOS jailbreak, functions are modified by adding an unconditional trampoline in the first 4 words.
FunctionName contains the function that has been determined to have been tampered with,  ImageFileName contains the path to the image where the
trampoline jumps to, and ExecutableBytes contains the first 4 words of the tampered-with function where the trampoline was detected.
